title: Apprentice Quest Board & Rank Lock Fix (v0.4.40)
message: Fixed premature rank unlocking on account claim. Restored the Apprentice Quest Board and re-locked rank progression until all 8 apprentice quests are completed.
changelog:
🛡️ EMERGENCY APPRENTICE QUEST FIX v0.4.40:
• Restored Apprentice Quest Board: Newly claimed student accounts are properly designated as Apprentices (is_onboarded = false) instead of prematurely unlocking the full ranking system.
• Quest Integrity & Self-Healing: Accounts that had their quest board disappear upon claim are automatically detected and restored to Apprentice mode until all 8 quests are completed.
• Rank & Feature Lock: Leaderboard, Daily Quests, and XP progression remain securely locked behind the 8 initiation trials as originally designed.
